prior.note: interiorFeel.ts now sets flashLeft = FLASH_TICKS / TICK_HZ in onHit and drains it by realDt every frame. The flash shows only while flashLeft > 0 and flashAlpha(ticksSince) > 0, so it ends on real time even when state.tick stops. In the ended duel, duelMode.ts:88 passes dt as both presentDt and realDt, so it drains. While paused, realDt = dt also drains it. The sector renderer passes the real dt (renderer.ts diff). build() and reset() clear flashLeft. A hitstop does not extend it, because flashLeft drains on realDt and not pdt. The new test holds state.tick at 10 and expects the flash hidden. At 1/60 frames, 1/30 - 2×(1/60) comes out to exactly 0, so no stray third frame is lit.

paused = dt === 0 && realDt > 0. While paused, clock.advance(0) leaves t held, clock.drain(realDt) (presentClock.ts:31) ends a running hitstop, and the wasStopped check runs after the drain, so freezeAnimations releases the sprites. stepShake drains on realDt and the returned offset is {0,0}. duelMode.ts:88 passes 0 or dt as presentDt and dt as realDt, and the sector renderer passes paused ? 0 : dt plus dt. The new test runs 4 paused frames of 1/60 s. That covers the 0.0433 s of hitstop left after the hit frame, and the test checks that time() is held and anim.playing is true.
